name: a link without <bdi> is never the title element (the pre-fix behaviour)
why: The INLINE STUFF track/recording-name rewrite leaves the release tracklist's title link without a <bdi>, and every Title-info feature goes blind on that cell: no ETI, no green italics, no title finding. Must fail on the detection test.

name: a bdi-less sub-path link (/recording/<mbid>/open_edits) counts as the title
why: A tool link such as INLINE STUFF's "Open"/"edits" would be read as the title. No fixture has such a link ahead of the title link in a title cell, so the suite cannot see this guard; a fixture with INLINE STUFF's toolzone links in front of the track link would cover it.
grep: both groups are ETI|keeps only its row

name: a text-less link (an image link) counts as the title
why: An entity link holding only an image would become the title element and parse as an empty title, hiding the real title behind it. No fixture has a text-less entity link ahead of a title link; an inline-artwork title cell with a thumbnail link in front would cover it.
grep: both groups are ETI|keeps only its row
